newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BZ Group says UBS stake hardly changed.
newsitem.headline: BZ Group says UBS stake hardly changed.

text.p: BZ Group said purchases of Winterthur Insurance shares were partially financed by the sale of Union Bank of Switzerland UBS UBS.S.S shares but the investment trust's stake in UBS has not changed significantly.
BZ Group controls BK Vision BKVZ.S, the investment trust which is Union Bank of Switzerland's UBS.S largest shareholder.

BZ spokesman Stefan Holzer said in response to an enquiry that an unspecified portion of UBS bearer shares held by the trust were sold to help finance recent purchases of Winterthur Insurance WINZn.S shares.
But BK Vision's stake in UBS has not changed significantly because the bearer shares sold were covered by options to buy additional UBS shares, Holzer said.
He also said in response to an enquiry that there have been no changes in the trust's relationship to UBS.

BK Vision in February reported that it held about a 9.0 percent stake in Union Bank of Switzerland's registered shares, and 5.3 percent of its bearer shares as of the end 1996. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
